issues.description: Deleting vstd_extra's public injective_on definition removes the name formerly re-exported through vstd_extra::prelude, but lock-protocol-rcu's unchanged proof still calls injective_on without importing vstd::relations::injective_on.
issues.rationale: At the problem snapshot, vstd_extra/src/function_properties.rs imports vstd::relations privately for its own uses but no longer defines a public injective_on item. vstd_extra/src/prelude.rs therefore cannot re-export that deleted name. The caller imports vstd_extra::prelude and several vstd modules but not vstd::relations::injective_on, so the unqualified ensures expression cannot resolve. The direct child repair adds exactly that import while leaving the proof call unchanged.
issues.source_evidence: after/vstd_extra/src/function_properties.rs no longer contains the public injective_on definition; after/vstd_extra/src/prelude.rs:11 still glob re-exports function_properties; after/lock-protocol-rcu/src/spec/utils.rs:1-10 lacks the relations import while lines 1161-1164 use injective_on. repair aa2547b7ff107ddfdfb3ac756740473faeb3e093 adds use vstd::relations::injective_on at line 10.
issues.verification: The immutable source history and direct repair establish a Rust/Verus name-resolution failure. Historical Verus was not executed; the direct child changes only the missing import.
